title: PIQI Score Result
description: Schema describing the output of a PIQI EvaluationRun: the scored result of running a rubric against a single message/payload, including per-data-class scores, message-level totals, and supporting detail lists.

elapsedTimeInMS.description: Time taken to score the message, in milliseconds.

succeeded.description: Whether the scoring run completed successfully.

scoringData.description: The full scoring output for the message, present when the run succeeded.

channelMnemonic.description: Mnemonic of the data channel/pipeline the message was submitted through.

dataProviderID.description: Identifier of the organization/system that provided the data.

dataSourceID.description: Identifier of the specific data source/feed the message came from.

evaluationRubric.description: Name of the rubric used to score this message.

messageID.description: Identifier of the scored message, typically derived from the source filename.

processDate.description: Timestamp when the message was processed/scored.

dataClassResults.description: PIQI scoring rolled up per data class present in the rubric's target model.

informationalResults.description: Non-scoring, informational evaluations rolled up per data class, providing visibility into criteria that don't affect the score (e.g., scoringEffect other than Scoring).

detectionResults.description: Results of detection-type evaluations (e.g., pattern/anomaly detection criteria) for this message. No populated example was available; item shape is permissive pending a representative sample.

plausibilityResults.description: Results of plausibility-check evaluations for this message. No populated example was available; item shape is permissive pending a representative sample.

scoreSummary.description: A PIQI score summary: numerator/denominator counts and the resulting score, both raw and weighted.

criticalFailureCount.description: Number of failed criteria flagged with criticalityIndicator = true.

denominator.description: Total number of criteria evaluations that were applicable (the count a passing evaluation is measured against).

numerator.description: Number of applicable criteria evaluations that passed.

piqiScore.description: Unweighted PIQI score as a percentage (numerator / denominator * 100), rounded.

weightedDenominator.description: Denominator after applying each criterion's scoringWeight.

weightedNumerator.description: Numerator after applying each criterion's scoringWeight.

weightedPIQIScore.description: Weighted PIQI score as a percentage (weightedNumerator / weightedDenominator * 100), rounded.

dataClassResult.description: PIQI score summary for a single data class, plus the number of instances of that data class found in the message.

dataClassName.description: Name of the data class this score summarizes.

instanceCount.description: Number of instances of this data class found in the message (0 if the data class was not present).

criticalFailureCount.description: Number of failed criteria flagged with criticalityIndicator = true, within this data class.

denominator.description: Total number of applicable criteria evaluations within this data class.

numerator.description: Number of applicable criteria evaluations that passed within this data class.

piqiScore.description: Unweighted PIQI score for this data class, as a percentage.

weightedDenominator.description: Denominator for this data class after applying scoringWeight.

weightedNumerator.description: Numerator for this data class after applying scoringWeight.

weightedPIQIScore.description: Weighted PIQI score for this data class, as a percentage.

evaluationDetail.description: Detail of a single criterion's evaluation outcome across all instances of its entity within the message.

entityName.description: Display name of the entity/attribute evaluated by this criterion.

evaluationName.description: Display name of the criterion's passing condition (the rubric criterion's samNameOverride).
examples: line payment denial code is populated

instanceCount.description: Number of instances of the entity found in the message.

denominator.description: Number of applicable evaluations for this criterion.

numerator.description: Number of applicable evaluations for this criterion that passed.

dataClassEvaluationGroup.description: A list of criterion-level evaluation details, grouped by data class.

dataClassName.description: Name of the data class these evaluations belong to.

evaluationList.description: Evaluation details for each applicable criterion within this data class.
